params.definitionOfDone: how you can tell it is done
params.claimConfirmation: whether taking it on needs confirming
params.claimLease: how long someone may hold it

claimTask.what: Take on a task: you will do it.

confirmClaim.what: Confirm that someone may do a task.

getTaskSnapshot.what: Show a task as it is now.

attachTaskGrant.what: Give someone extra rights for this task, until the task is done.

reassignTask.what: Give a task to someone else.

submitTask.what: Hand in a task for approval.

approveTask.what: Approve a task that was handed in.

rejectTask.what: Turn down a task that was handed in, and say why.

revokeTask.what: Withdraw a task, and say why.

listMine.what: Show what you still have to do.

listClaimable.what: Show tasks nobody has taken on yet.

listClaimConflicts.what: Show tasks two people took on at once.

resolveClaim.what: Choose who does a task two people took on at once.

listAwaitingApproval.what: Show handed in tasks waiting for approval.

listMyMasteredTasks.what: Show the tasks you look after.

listMyPendingClaims.what: Show who wants to do a task of yours and waits for you.

approveSubtaskRequest.what: Approve a request for a subtask.

declineSubtaskRequest.what: Turn down a request for a subtask.

params.olderThanMs: only those older than this many milliseconds

getDagTree.what: Show a task with everything under it.

archiveCircle.what: Archive the circle; everything is kept.

unarchiveCircle.what: Bring the circle back from the archive.

params.definitionOfDone: how you can tell it is done

getMyAvailability.what: Show when you are free this week.

setMyAvailability.what: Say whether you are free for half a day.

params.cellKey: week, day, morning or afternoon, free or not

setAvailabilityOptIn.what: Say whether others may see when you are free.

suggestSchedule.what: Suggest times to work on your tasks.

getMyCircles.what: Show your circles, with what is open in each.

listMyTasksAcrossCircles.what: Show all your open tasks, in all your circles.

getCircleConfig.what: Show how the circle is set up.

listCircleMembers.what: Show the members of the circle, with their role.

pauseCircle.what: Pause the circle: no new tasks, the old ones go on.

unpauseCircle.what: Start the circle again after a pause.

issueInvite.what: Make an invite to the circle that works once.

params.ttl-hours: for how many hours it holds

redeemInvite.what: Join a circle with an invite.

addSubtask.what: Make a subtask under a task.

params.definitionOfDone: how you can tell it is done

proposeSubtask.what: Propose a subtask under a task that was handed in.

params.definitionOfDone: how you can tell it is done

forceSpawnSubtask.what: As admin, make a subtask anyway, outside the usual rules.
